greet: Ehen, you don find my lamp. We dey call am fitila.
greet.ask: Wetin dem dey call the lamp?
made: Na the same river clay wey dem take make the pot dem take mould am, e small reach to sidon for your palm.
oil: We go pour palm oil inside, come put wick wey dem twist from cotton for im mouth. Then we light the wick.
before: Before lantern and NEPA light come, every house go light one of dis one for evening time. The whole street go dey shine with small small fire.
before.ask: Wetin people dey use before electric light?
grandmother: My grandmama tell her own stories for the light of dis same lamp, the way I dey tell you my own.
night: When sun go down, im small fire dey help us find our mat, and we go tell stories reach deep night.
care: Carry am stand straight, slowly slowly, my pikin, or the oil go pour come quench the fire.
